message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper, dried oregano, basil, red‑pepper flakes | to taste |
| | Optional: red wine, bay leaf, carrot or celery (finely diced) | ¼ cup wine, 1 leaf, ½ cup diced veg |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (120 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp (60 g) |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp (30 g) |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 3 cups (720 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, salt, pepper | pinch nutmeg, to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups (200–300 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (120 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup (120 g) |

### Optional extras
- **Vegetables**: sliced zucchini, spinach, mushrooms, or roasted bell peppers can be layered for extra flavor and nutrition.
- **Herbs**: fresh basil or oregano added to the ricotta mixture or sprinkled on top before baking.
- **Spices**: a dash of smoked paprika or a splash of balsamic vinegar in the meat sauce for depth.

With these ingredients, you’ll have everything you need to assemble a hearty, flavorful lasagna. Enjoy!
